title: Division of labour
author: Wikipedia contributors
paragraphs: The division of labour is the separation of the tasks in any economic system or organisation so that participants may specialise (specialisation). Individuals, organisations, and nations are endowed with, or acquire, specialised capabilities and either form combinations or trade to take advantage of others' capabilities in addition to their own. Specialised capabilities may include equipment, natural resources, and skills. Training and the integration of equipment and other assets are often important. For example, an individual may specialise by acquiring tools and the skills to use them effectively, just as an organisation may specialise by acquiring specialised equipment and hiring or training skilled operators. The division of labour is the motive for trade and the source of economic interdependence.

An increasing division of labour is associated with the growth of total output and trade, the rise of capitalism, and the increasing complexity of industrialised processes. The concept and implementation of division of labour has been observed in ancient Sumerian (Mesopotamian) culture, where assignment of jobs in some cities coincided with an increase in trade and economic interdependence. Division of labour generally increases both overall producer productivity and individual worker productivity.

After the Neolithic Revolution, pastoralism and agriculture led to more reliable and abundant food supplies, which increased the population and spurred the specialisation of labour, including the emergence of new classes of artisans and warriors, as well as the development of elites. This specialisation was furthered by the process of industrialisation, and Industrial Revolution-era factories. Accordingly, many classical economists as well as some mechanical engineers, such as Charles Babbage, were proponents of the division of labour. Also, having lower-paid but more productive unskilled workers perform single or limited tasks eliminated and replaced the long training period required for artisans.

sentence.text: The division of labour is the motive for trade and the source of economic interdependence.
sentence.translation: 劳动分工是贸易的动因，也是经济相互依赖的来源。
sentence.analysis: 主干为 The division of labour is…。the motive 与 the source 是由 and 连接的并列表语；for trade 修饰 motive，of economic interdependence 修饰 source。

questions.question: 根据第一段，劳动分工为什么要划分任务？
options: 让参与者能够专门从事某类工作
使每个人必须掌握所有职业
消除任何设备和技能的差别
questions.explanation: 首句中 so that participants may specialise 明确说明划分任务的目的。
hints: 区分原因与结果，不要把相关现象直接当作因果。
回到第 1 段，逐项核对主体、范围及表示条件或程度的词。

questions.question: 文中给出的组织实现专业化的一种方式是什么？
options: 停止对员工进行任何培训
购置专用设备，并招聘或培训熟练操作人员
要求所有员工同时完成所有任务
放弃使用设备和其他资产
questions.explanation: 第一段以 acquiring specialised equipment and hiring or training skilled operators 为例说明组织如何专业化。
